summary: A six-track Felucca-based synth groovebox styled after the GammaWave desktop synth, with eight sample-free engines, extra filter and drive types and a song generator that covers 49 genres.
features: Engines: analog, 6-op FM, phase distortion, lo-fi/bytebeat, voice, organ, noise, drums
VOWEL and SCREAM filters, four new drive types, six Hearth macros
49-genre generator incl. trap and drill; 32 saved takes, played like clips
MUTATE evolves a track's notes and sound every few bars
Punch-in FX, five reverbs, master clip, punch and sidechain duck
Browser studio edits over Web MIDI; uses the user sample flash
